messages:
sarah.cs: Heads up — Nova Health renewal in ~6 weeks. We saw a big usage spike last month and finance flagged runway. Need a short QBR prep focusing on spend forecast and preservation actions. Can Diego + Lakshmi join?

diego.revops: On it. I pulled their billing slice — sending quick breakdown below. We should flag renewal risk if we don't present a clear cost plan.

cost-bot: Alert: monthly spend increased 3.4x MoM for customer=nova-health. Budget threshold exceeded on 2026-02-28.

lakshmi.se: Thanks. Can you paste the month-by-month tokens and model mix? want to recommend batching + a quant path if feasible.

diego.revops: Copy of raw:
```
2026-01    22,400,000 tokens    $4,480    baseline model: small-3b
2026-02    28,900,000 tokens    $5,780    baseline model: small-3b
2026-03    96,200,000 tokens    $19,240   sudden adoption of chat+streaming (gpt-open-4 equivalent)
```
Notably p95 latency didn't change much; looks like higher concurrency from one product line.

maya_nova: Sorry — we launched a new in-app assistant for one team mid-Feb. It's still in beta and we didn't gate the traffic. Won't happen again but need guidance on limits and a cost plan.

sarah.cs: OK — action items: 1) triage the spike cause (Maya + Eng). 2) Recommend immediate guardrails (rate limits + quota per org team). 3) Propose a cost-reduction runway for the QBR (commits / model mix / batching). Can Tilly help coordinate slides for the exec QBR?

tilly.am: I can take slide ownership. Diego — can you send a short spend forecast with two scenarios (conservative + growth) by EOD Friday? Also include suggested threshold for budget alerts.

lakshmi.se: Early suggestions from an SE perspective:
- Enable soft rate limits and per-team quotas (low lift)
- Turn on prefix KV caching for the assistant where it's applicable
- Run a quick model-profiling job to evaluate switching to a faster quantized variant for completion-only paths
- Add server-side sampling (nucleus p=.9) to lower token counts for low-value interactions

diego.revops: Draft scenarios: conservative assumes 20% month-over-month deceleration after product fixes; growth assumes continued +10% MoM. I'll attach numbers to the slides. Proposed budget alert: 3-day moving avg > $1,000/day triggers pager to CS + RevOps; weekly overrun > 20% triggers customer outreach.

maya_nova: Appreciate the plan. We need a migration guide for model settings; can Lakshmi run a 30-min enablement session for our eng team?

lakshmi.se: Yes — I can do a workshop next Tue. Will bring a checklist and exact flag changes.

sarah.cs: For the QBR deck let's include: short incident timeline, spend chart, root cause (product path), mitigation plan (rate limits, batching, quant), forecast scenarios, renewal ask (2-month committed discount / stepped commit), and an enablement offer.

diego.revops: Putting numbers into a slide now. Quick ask: Sarah, do we want to propose a 2-month trial commit at 30% discount to get them back on predictable spend? That usually reduces renewal risk.

sarah.cs: Yes propose the trial commit + optional autoscale cap. We'll run it by Jane (AM) before presenting.

cost-bot: Note added to customer profile: temporary alert thresholds set.

maya_nova: Thanks team — the enablement session + a clear commit plan will help. I'll prep a short internal note to pause non-critical assistant traffic until we meet.

lakshmi.se: I'll add a preflight checklist: flags to set, sample prompt dedup rules, KV cache keys, and a small profiling script we can hand them.

diego.revops: Final: sending a conservative vs growth table into the deck now. Will ping when done.

sarah.cs: Great. Let's meet Wed 11am for pre-QBR runthrough. Tilly will own deck, Lakshmi leads enablement, Diego owns forecast numbers, Maya to confirm traffic pause. Thanks all :thumbsup:
